name: Silkflex Polymers (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2016, Silkflex Polymers 
India Ltd is in the business of Chemicals 
and Printing dyes and water based Wood Coatings[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does trading of textile printing inks and water-based wood coating polymers products of a Malaysian  based brand - Silkflex produced by Silkflex Polymers SDN BHD (Silkflex Malaysia). It is one of the garment printing ink manufacturers of Malaysia supplying products around the globe through its authorised agents, including countries like India, Thailand, Turkey, Russia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Indonesia

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 82.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Debtor days have increased from 35.3 to 46.1 days.
Working capital days have increased from 69.7 days to 163 days
